entries.quote: Mice with transplanted human colon cancer cells received oplopantriol A" and "tumor growth inhibition occurred in a dose-related manner.
entries.population_or_system: Mice with transplanted human colon cancer cells
entries.limitations: Animal xenograft only. Single compound (oplopantriol A from Oplopanax horridus). Dose-related tumor growth inhibition, no adverse events in mice. Not human evidence.

entries.quote: One of them (HCT-116) showed a significant sensitivity to oplopantriol A.
entries.body_site: Not specified for this cell-line comparison (site within colorectum not specified)
entries.population_or_system: HCT-116 and SW-480 human colorectal cancer cell lines; HCT-116 (p53 wild-type) significantly sensitive, SW-480 (p53 mutant) not
entries.limitations: In vitro only. Response in one of two cell lines. p53 status may be linked. Not human evidence.
